description: Save a plan (markdown) as a versioned lake-gate plan and ask teammates to review it on the PR. Returns the plan id, version, model and cost estimate, and the review link. Use after planning, before implementing. Tip: add a "Model: <name>" line to declare which model runs it.

plan_id.description: Plan id (defaults to the active plan, or derived from the title)

plan_markdown.description: Full plan in markdown. Omit to request review of an existing plan.

push.description: Commit only the plan file and push the current branch (so the PR shows this version)

reviewers.description: GitHub logins to request review from

name: lake_request_review
